newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan approves US$997 mln foreign fund investment.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan approves US$997 mln foreign fund investment.

text.p: Taiwan's Securities and Exchange Commission has approved US$997 million worth of investment by foreign funds in the island's stock market, a daily approval record for foreign funds.
"The SEC on Tuesday just approved nine foreign fund applications to invest a total of US$997 million in Taiwan's stock market, a daily approval record," an SEC official said by telephone.
"Application of foreign fund entries will likely hit another monthly record in September," he said.
Between September 1 and 10, the SEC received 27 foreign fund applications worth a total US$3.657 billion and had approved 12 worth US$1.317 billion, he said.
Foreign fund inflows have accelerated since Morgan Stanley said it was including Taiwan in its global stock indices from September 2.
In August, the SEC received 30 foreign fund applications worth a toal US$3.177 billion. It approved inflows of US$2.826 billion, the official said. Both figures were monthly records.
